info.title: FileFeed API
info.description: Official FileFeed REST API for connections, pipelines, schemas, pipeline runs, webhooks, outbound uploads, documents, files, and notifications. Date-based API versioning is controlled by the `FileFeed-Version` request header (default `2024-09-01`; latest `2026-05-25`); this document describes the `2026-05-25` shape.

get.summary: Get presigned URL for original file
Get presigned URL for processed file

get.description: Compares the processed files of two runs of the SAME pipeline (for example yesterday's ingest vs today's) and returns the records added and removed. The diff is a whole-record multiset difference — the platform has no record-identity key, so a changed row surfaces as one removed plus one added. Both runs must belong to the same pipeline, must be in a processed state (`completed`, `delivered`, or `acknowledged`), and must be visible to the caller. The response carries summary counts plus a single paginated `changes` list (added entries first, then removed).

parameters.name: baseRunId
parameters.description: Baseline (earlier) pipeline run id — the "before" side.

parameters.name: compareRunId
parameters.description: Comparison (later) pipeline run id — the "after" side. Must belong to the same pipeline as baseRunId.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset into the flattened changes list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of change entries to return (1–1000).

200.description: The delta between the two runs.

400.description: Same run id given twice, the two runs belong to different pipelines, a run is not in a processed state, or a processed file is not a record array.

404.description: A run was not found in the workspace or is not visible to the caller.

post.description: Verifies an SFTP connection with a live login. For an EMAIL connection this is a no-op that returns `success: false` with an explanatory message (still HTTP 200, not an error).

get.description: **Deprecated** as of API version `2026-05-25`. Use [`GET /connections`](#tag/connections/get/connections) instead. Sunset: 2027-05-25.

post.description: **Deprecated** as of API version `2026-05-25`. Use [`POST /connections`](#tag/connections/post/connections) instead. Sunset: 2027-05-25.

201.description: Webhook created. The response includes the signing `secret` — shown once, never returned again.

post.summary: Initialize an outbound multipart upload session
post.description: Creates a new upload session for pushing JSON data into an outbound pipeline. The pipeline must have `direction: "outbound"`.

put.summary: Upload one part for an outbound upload session
put.description: Upload a single part (JSON array of objects). Part numbers are 1-based and must not exceed `totalParts`.

post.summary: Complete outbound multipart upload and trigger processing
post.description: Combines all uploaded parts into one file, stores it in S3, and triggers pipeline processing. The number of parts listed must match `totalParts`.

example.message: Upload a1b2c3d4 completed. Processing started for employees.json

post.summary: Abort outbound multipart upload and cleanup temp parts
post.description: Cancels an in-progress upload session, deletes all temporary parts from storage, and marks the session as aborted. Further uploads to this session will be rejected.

example.message: Upload a1b2c3d4 aborted and cleaned up

get.description: Returns the current state of an upload session including which parts have been uploaded.
List one page of folders and files under a path within a connection (drive).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder path relative to the connection root (empty = root).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Pagination token from a previous page.

200.description: One page of folders and files

get.summary: Get a processed JSON file by name
get.description: Retrieve a processed JSON file's content, located by connection name, file name, and pipeline. Supply offset/limit to page an array file.

parameters.name: clientName
parameters.description: The connection's display name the file belongs to.

post.description: Search rows across processed files belonging to the given pipeline runs. pipelineRunIds is required; omit searchTerm to return all rows.

get.description: List a connection's notification preferences, ordered by event type then channel. The path segment is named `clientId` for back-compat — it is the connection id.

put.description: Upsert a connection's preferences, matched on (eventType, channel). An enabled preference requires at least one recipient.

post.description: Registers a workspace-level PIPELINE_RUN_EVENT webhook that fires on every run.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden — e.g. a protected pipeline folder without admin + force.

Conflict.description: Conflict — e.g. the target already exists.

pipelineDirection.description: Direction of the pipeline that produced this run.

pipelineName.description: Name of the originating pipeline. `DELETED PIPELINE` when the pipeline was deleted.

isPipelineDeleted.description: True when the originating pipeline has been deleted.

client.description: Originating connection's display name, resolved from the SFTP/email child connection.

total.description: Total number of records in the pipeline run.

returned.description: Number of records returned in this page.

PipelineRunDeltaSummary.description: Aggregate counts for a pipeline-run delta.

baseCount.description: Records in the base run's processed file.

compareCount.description: Records in the compare run's processed file.

addedCount.description: Records present in the compare run but not the base run.

removedCount.description: Records present in the base run but not the compare run.

PipelineRunDeltaChange.description: A single changed record. `added` = present only in the compare run; `removed` = present only in the base run.

record.description: The processed record (a row of the processed file) that was added or removed.

PipelineRunDeltaPagination.description: Pagination metadata for the flattened changes list.

returned.description: Number of change entries returned in this page.

PipelineRunDelta.description: Record-level delta between two runs of the same pipeline.

pipelineId.description: The pipeline definition both runs belong to.

changes.description: Changed records for this page (added first, then removed).

Connection.description: An SFTP / Email / API endpoint with its credentials. Canonical name as of API version `2026-05-25` (formerly `Client`). Credentials (sftpPassword / sftpPrivateKey / sftpPassphrase / awsPassword) are write-only and never returned in responses.

type.description: Connection kind. Always present as of API version `2026-05-25`.

awsUserName.description: Server-generated SFTP username slug for a FileFeed-hosted connection. (Outbound uploads reference a connection by its human-readable `name`, not this slug.)

SftpServerData.description: The SFTP server a connection is bound to. For a self-hosted connection, host/port/rootDirectory describe the customer endpoint FileFeed dials out to; for a hosted connection, the FileFeed-managed AWS Transfer server.

EmailInbox.description: Resolved inbox config for an EMAIL connection. Returned on `Connection.emailInbox`, present only when `type` = `EMAIL`.

inboundAddress.description: Address mail is delivered to, e.g. feed-7t9w@in.filefeed.io.

allowedSenders.description: Full emails or @domain.com patterns. Empty = allow all senders.

subjectFilter.description: Case-insensitive subject substring filter. Null = no filter.

type.description: Connection kind. Defaults to SFTP. Set to EMAIL to create an email inbox connection — the email* fields then apply and SFTP fields are ignored.

sftpHost.description: Self-hosted SFTP (useHostedSFTP=false): the customer SFTP host FileFeed dials out to.

emailAllowedSenders.description: EMAIL only. Allowed senders — full address (alice@acme.com) or root-domain pattern (@acme.com). Empty/omitted = accept any sender.

emailAllowedFormats.description: EMAIL only. Attachment accept-list. Required and non-empty for EMAIL connections.

emailSubjectFilter.description: EMAIL only. Case-insensitive substring required in the subject. Empty = no filter.

emailInboundAddress.description: EMAIL only, create-only and immutable. Custom inbound address {workspace-slug}.{connection-slug}@in.filefeed.io. Omit to have one generated (feed-XXXX@in.filefeed.io).

Client.description: **Deprecated** — alias for [Connection](#schema/Connection). Removed when API version `2024-09-01` sunsets on 2027-05-25.

SchemaDefinition.description: A JSON Schema document describing the columns the processed data must conform to.

properties.description: Map of column name to JSON Schema property, e.g. { id: { type: "string" } }.

required.description: Column names that must be present (at least one).

isActive.description: Always present in responses (currently always true).

CreateSchemaParams.description: The schema body is a JSON Schema `definition` object. The legacy `fields` array is ignored by the API.

errors.description: Raw AJV error objects (present when `valid` is false).

FieldMapping.description: One field mapping. Either sourced ({ source, target, transform? } — copies a column from the input), static ({ target, value } — writes a literal constant into the target on every row; omit `source`), or aggregated ({ sources, target, delimiter? } — joins several input columns into one target, in order, joined by `delimiter`, skipping empty values; a `transform`, if set, runs on the joined result). Aggregated mappings are in limited availability and must be enabled for your workspace — a request that uses them on a workspace without the feature is rejected with 400.

source.description: Source column name. Omit for a static or aggregated mapping.

transform.description: Optional transform key (sourced and aggregated mappings; not applied to static values).

value.description: Static literal written to `target` on every row. Presence marks the mapping static. Provide instead of `source`/`sources`.

sources.description: Source columns to combine into `target`, joined by `delimiter` (in order; empty values are skipped). Provide instead of `source`. Presence marks the mapping aggregated. Limited availability — requires the field-aggregation feature.

delimiter.description: Separator used to join `sources` (default a single space). An explicit empty string concatenates with no separator. Only used with `sources`.

PipelineMappings.description: The mapping definition the API expects. Field mappings live under `fieldMappings`; not a bare array.

options.description: Parsing hints: delimiter, skipHeaderRow, detectTypes, validateData.

validations.description: Optional per-target validation overrides, keyed by target column.

direction.description: Pipeline direction. Outbound pipelines accept data via the Outbound Uploads API.

clientId.description: Connection id this pipeline is bound to.

webhooks.description: Webhooks linked to this pipeline. Present and non-empty only when the pipeline has associated webhooks.

direction.description: Set to "outbound" to create a pipeline that accepts data via the Outbound Uploads API.

clientId.description: Connection id this pipeline is bound to.

isActive.description: Whether the pipeline is active on creation. Backend default: true.

Webhook.description: Webhook read shape. The signing `secret` is NOT returned on reads — it is shown only once on the create response (see CreateWebhookResponse).

eventType.description: Defaults to GENERAL. Set server-side; not accepted on create/update.

CreateWebhookResponse.description: Returned by `POST /webhooks` only. Identical to Webhook plus the generated signing `secret`, which is shown once here and never again.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Store it now — it is never returned again.

CreateWebhookParams.description: eventType and secret are not accepted on create/update: the server defaults eventType to GENERAL and generates the secret (both returned on the Webhook response).

webhookName.description: Display name of the webhook this delivery targeted, when available.

webhookUrl.description: Destination URL of the webhook this delivery targeted, when available.

connectionName.description: The connection's human-readable name. Resolves identically for hosted and self-hosted SFTP.

clientName.description: Deprecated: use connectionName. Resolved by the connection's name.

pipelineName.description: Name of the outbound pipeline (must have direction: "outbound").

totalParts.description: Total number of parts to upload.

filename.description: Optional final filename. Defaults to upload-{uploadId}.json.

outputFilename.description: Exact name for the delivered file. Extension appended from outputFormat if omitted.

outputFormat.description: Output serialization. Overrides format; inferred from outputFilename extension if omitted, else defaults to JSON.

data.description: Array of JSON objects for this part.

uploadedParts.description: Number of parts uploaded so far.

etag.description: Optional ETag for the uploaded part.

parts.description: Ordered list of all parts. Count must match totalParts.

path.description: Folder path relative to the connection root.

size.description: Total size in bytes (omitted for very large folders).

path.description: File path relative to the connection root.

nextToken.description: Token for the next page; omitted when exhausted.

UploadTicket.description: Presigned upload ticket. mode=single → PUT the whole file to url; mode=multipart → PUT each part to parts[].url then complete with uploadId + ETags.

path.description: Destination folder relative to the connection root (empty = root).

size.description: File size in bytes (decides single vs multipart).

isFolder.description: Whether the item is a folder (recursive) or a single object.

JsonFileResponse.description: When the stored file is a JSON array and offset/limit are supplied, a paginated envelope is returned; otherwise the raw parsed JSON is returned (pagination absent).

searchTerm.description: Omit to return all rows from the given runs.

NotificationPreference.description: A stored per-connection notification preference. The connection FK is named `clientId` on the wire (the v1 term).

clientId.description: The connection this preference is scoped to.

recipients.description: Required and non-empty when isEnabled is true; ignored when false.
